headline.en: Find suspicious instructions in repository text
headline.zh: 找出仓库文本中的可疑指令

sub.en: PromptShield scans the text a coding agent may read, highlights prompt-injection patterns with source locations, and returns a CI failure when HIGH findings remain.
sub.zh: PromptShield 扫描编程 Agent 可能读取的文本，用源码位置标出提示注入模式，并在仍有 HIGH 发现项时让 CI 返回失败。

body.en: Findings retain file, line, surface, rule and rationale.
body.zh: 发现项保留文件、行号、文本类型、规则及原因。

body.en: The optional decode pass adds base64, hex and Unicode-normalized variants.
body.zh: 默认解码阶段增加 Base64、十六进制和 Unicode 归一化变体。

body.en: Scan a path, added diff lines with commit messages, or saved GitHub PR-files JSON.
body.zh: 可扫描路径、Diff 新增行及提交信息，或保存的 GitHub PR 文件 JSON。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: The script runs the real CLI over the shipped clean.py and utils.py fixtures, summarizes their JSON results, and checks the expected 0/1 exit codes. The suspicious file is only read as text.
note.zh: 脚本用真实 CLI 扫描随仓 clean.py 和 utils.py，汇总 JSON 结果并核对预期的 0/1 退出码。可疑文件仅作为文本读取。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Static analysis of shipped benign/malicious Python fixtures with actual CLI exit codes; no fixture execution.

body.en: The script runs the real CLI over the shipped clean.py and utils.py fixtures, summarizes their JSON results, and checks the expected 0/1 exit codes. The suspicious file is only read as text.
body.zh: 脚本用真实 CLI 扫描随仓 clean.py 和 utils.py，汇总 JSON 结果并核对预期的 0/1 退出码。可疑文件仅作为文本读取。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/promptshield.git
cd promptshield
uv venv --python 3.12
source .venv/bin/activate
uv pip install -e .

limitations.en: Pattern matching can miss novel attacks or flag legitimate examples. No findings is not a proof that text is safe for an agent.
limitations.zh: 模式匹配可能漏过新攻击，也可能标记合法示例。没有发现项并不能证明文本适合交给 Agent。

limitations.en: Decoding covers implemented transformations, not arbitrary obfuscation or model behavior.
limitations.zh: 解码只覆盖已实现变换，不覆盖任意混淆方式或模型行为。

limitations.en: The demo verifies fixture detection, not whether a model follows or ignores injected instructions.
limitations.zh: 示例验证样本检测，不验证模型是否遵循或忽略注入指令。

body.en: Comments, documentation and commit messages can contain instructions addressed to an agent. Reviewing those surfaces separately from executable behavior helps identify suspicious directions before they enter the agent’s context.
body.zh: 注释、文档和提交信息中可能夹带针对 Agent 的指令。单独审阅这些文本表面，有助于在进入 Agent 上下文之前发现可疑要求。

body.en: Collectors identify supported comment, document and change surfaces. The decoder creates additional variants without losing source attribution. YAML rules classify matches, scanner.py deduplicates and sorts findings, and the baseline suppresses accepted fingerprints. Table, JSON and SARIF outputs share one ScanResult.
body.zh: 收集器识别支持的注释、文档和变更文本。解码器在保留来源的同时创建额外变体；YAML 规则分类匹配项，scanner.py 去重排序，baseline 按指纹过滤已接受项。表格、JSON 和 SARIF 共享同一个 ScanResult。

title.en: Collect text, match rules, apply reviewed exceptions
title.zh: 收集文本、匹配规则、应用已审例外

body.en: Collectors identify supported comment, document and change surfaces. The decoder creates additional variants without losing source attribution. YAML rules classify matches, scanner.py deduplicates and sorts findings, and the baseline suppresses accepted fingerprints. Table, JSON and SARIF outputs share one ScanResult.
body.zh: 收集器识别支持的注释、文档和变更文本。解码器在保留来源的同时创建额外变体；YAML 规则分类匹配项，scanner.py 去重排序，baseline 按指纹过滤已接受项。表格、JSON 和 SARIF 共享同一个 ScanResult。

alt.en: Collect text, match rules, apply reviewed exceptions
alt.zh: 收集文本、匹配规则、应用已审例外

body.en: PromptShield reports textual patterns. A runtime must still enforce its own trust boundaries, and reviewers decide whether a flagged instruction is legitimate documentation or an attack. Rule packs and baselines let that review remain explicit.
body.zh: PromptShield 报告文本模式，运行时仍需执行自身信任边界。审阅者需判断被标记指令是正常文档还是攻击。规则包与 baseline 使这些审阅决策保持明确。

body.en: Repeat --rules with YAML files or directories to stack rule packs; later same-ID rules override earlier ones. --baseline selects an accepted-findings file, default .promptshield-baseline.yaml. --update-baseline writes all current findings and exits 0, so use it only after reviewing the findings. --no-decode disables decoding and --no-color disables terminal color. HIGH findings exit 1; MED and LOW findings alone do not.
body.zh: 可重复传入 --rules YAML 文件或目录叠加规则，后来的同 ID 规则覆盖前者。--baseline 指定接受项文件，默认 .promptshield-baseline.yaml。--update-baseline 会写入全部当前发现并返回 0，因此应在审阅之后使用。--no-decode 关闭解码，--no-color 关闭终端颜色。HIGH 返回 1，仅有 MED 或 LOW 不会。

body.en: The first example intentionally returns 1. --diff requires a valid Git reference in the selected repository. --pr accepts a saved PR-files JSON document; it does not fetch one automatically. Use --format sarif for CI ingestion or --format json for scripts. --diff and --pr are mutually exclusive.
body.zh: 第一条示例会按预期返回 1。--diff 需要所选仓库中有效的 Git 引用。--pr 接受保存的 PR 文件 JSON，不会自动获取。CI 接入可使用 --format sarif，脚本处理可使用 --format json。--diff 与 --pr 互斥。

details.code:
.venv/bin/promptshield scan ./tests/fixtures/malicious_pr --format json
.venv/bin/promptshield scan --diff HEAD~1 --repo . --format sarif
.venv/bin/promptshield rules list
